senses.en_definition: To perceive sounds with the ears; to hear.
To receive news or information; to hear about something.
To pay attention to, consider, or follow someone's words, advice, or instructions.

messages.en: Give this song a listen. I think you'll really like it.
Just finished listening. It's so good! Got any more songs like this? Send them my way.
I've sent you the recording. Have a listen first, okay?
Okay, I'll listen now. Give me a sec.

senses.en_definition: The front part of something, or the position or direction ahead.
Next or upcoming; in masa depan, the future.

messages.en: I'm here. I'm waiting out front of the shop, next to the red motorbike.
Oh, I see you now. I'm across the road. I'll be there in a sec.

senses.en_definition: A police officer who investigates crimes.

messages.en: That detective show you recommended is so good. I'm only on episode two, so don't tell me who the killer is, okay!
Haha, okay, my lips are sealed 🤐 We can talk about the ending once you've finished watching.
